meaning:
A womanof the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.8.8; married to Shaharaim (H7842)
§ Baara = "brutish"
one of the wives of Shaharaim, a Benjamite

elsewhere.note: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away. Hushim and Baara were his wives.
